Which one of the following is NOT true about rational expectation?  
*[UGC NET December 2025 · Q.89]*
options: Rational expectations theory has been developed by Hansen.
It is used in decision making by households, firms and labour for making their expectations about relevant variables.
The rational expectation uses all relevant information.
It is not an error free expectation.
questions.explanation: Rational expectations were developed by Muth (and Lucas), not Hansen.

questions.q:
Which one of the following is true for the phenomenon of Liquidity trap?  
*[UGC NET December 2025 · Q.103]*
options: The entire additional money supply is spent on buying bonds
The level of rate of interest is very high
The entire additional money supply is held by the public as idle cash balance
The interest rate will decrease from the point of liquidity trap
questions.explanation: In a liquidity trap extra money is held as idle balances.

*[UGC NET December 2025 · Q.110]*

Given below are two statements: one is labelled as Assertion (A) and the other is labelled as  
Reason (R).  
Assertion (A): Deficit spending by the government leads to crowding out effect on private  
investment.  
Reason (R): When the government finances its deficit by borrowing from the market, the bond  
prices go up and the rate of interest falls.  
In the light of the above statements, choose the most appropriate answer from the options  
given below:  
*[UGC NET December 2025 · Q.115]*
options: Both (A) and (R) are correct and (R) is the correct explanation of (A)
Both (A) and (R) are correct but (R) is not the correct explanation of (A)
(A) is correct but (R) is not correct
(A) is not correct but (R) is correct
questions.explanation: Deficit borrowing lowers bond prices and raises interest rates, crowding out investment.
